---
pagetitle: "SQUIRE 2.0 checklist"
page-layout: full
toc: false
resources:
  - /assets/logos/equator_logo.png
  - docx.min.js
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #tp-wrap { --accent:#215e99; --head:#4c94d8; --blue:#215e99; --box:#edf4fc; --boxline:#8fbbe6; --line:#333;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#111; max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:20px; font-weight:bold; line-height:1.25; margin:0 0 .2rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; margin:.4rem 0 .8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; width:100%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { flex:0 1 50%; min-width:0; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; padding:.35rem .5rem;
    border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); background:var(--box); border-radius:3px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.3; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1px dotted var(--line); padding:3px 6px; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap th { background:var(--head); color:#fff; font-weight:bold; text-align:left; }
  #tp-wrap th.c { text-align:center; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sec td { color:var(--blue); font-weight:bold; padding:4px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap td.topic { width:16%; vertical-align:top; font-style:italic; color:var(--blue); }
  #tp-wrap td.item { width:6%; text-align:center; vertical-align:top; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { width:11%; padding:3px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#6b86a6; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot { margin-top:.8rem; font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.35; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot ul { margin:.25rem 0 0; padding-left:1.2rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot li { margin:0 0 .1rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-cite { margin-top:1rem; font-size:14px; }
  /* Equator logo: hidden on screen, shown only in the saved PDF (print) */
  #tp-wrap .tp-eqrow { display:none; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-eq { width:150px; height:auto; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #215e99; background:#215e99; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#215e99; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 portrait; margin:12mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-eqrow { display:block; text-align:right; margin-bottom:.5rem; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:9.5px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:17px; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-foot { font-size:9.5px; break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:10.5px; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap tr.sec td, #tp-wrap td.topic { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { border:0; padding:0; background:none; flex:1 1 auto; }
  }
</style>

<div id="tp-wrap">
  <div class="tp-eqrow"><img src="/assets/logos/equator_logo.png" alt="EQUATOR Network" class="tp-eq"></div>
  <div class="tp-title">Revised Standards for Quality Improvement Reporting Excellence (SQUIRE 2.0)</div>
  <div class="tp-actions">
    <button type="button" id="tp-pdf">Save as PDF</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-doc" class="alt">Save as Word</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-reset" class="alt">Clear all</button>
    <p class="tp-note">Type the page number(s) where each item is reported in the blue boxes in the right-hand column, then save your copy as a PDF or Word (.docx) file.
    “Save as PDF” opens your browser’s print dialog: choose <em>Save as PDF</em> as the destination.
    Your entries stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-meta"><label>Manuscript title: <input type="text" id="tp-title" data-key="title" placeholder="Type your manuscript title here"></label></div>
  <table id="tp-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>Section &amp; Item name</th><th class="c">No</th><th>Item description <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></th>
      <th class="c">Reported on page #<span class="tp-hint">type page no. in the boxes below</span></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <div class="tp-foot"><strong><span aria-hidden="true">*</span> Notes to authors</strong><ul id="tp-notes"></ul></div>
  <p class="tp-cite">From Ogrinc G, Davies L, Goodman D, Batalden P, Davidoff F, Stevens D. SQUIRE 2.0 (Standards for QUality Improvement Reporting Excellence): revised publication guidelines from a detailed consensus process. <em>BMJ Qual Saf</em> 2016; 25:986-992. doi: <a href="https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjqs-2015-004411" target="_blank" rel="noopener">10.1136/bmjqs-2015-004411</a></p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // ["Item name", "item no.", "text"]; name "" = continuation row; plain strings = section bars
  const ROWS = [
    "TITLE AND ABSTRACT",
    ["Title", "1", "Indicate that the manuscript concerns an initiative to improve healthcare (broadly defined to include the quality, safety, effectiveness, patient-centeredness, timeliness, cost, efficiency, and equity of healthcare)"],
    ["Abstract", "2a", "Provide adequate information to aid in searching and indexing"],
    ["", "2b", "Summarize all key information from various sections of the text using the abstract format of the intended publication or a structured summary such as: background, local problem, methods, interventions, results, conclusions"],
    "INTRODUCTION: Why did you start?",
    ["Problem description", "3", "Nature and significance of the local problem"],
    ["Available knowledge", "4", "Summary of what is currently known about the problem, including relevant previous studies"],
    ["Rationale", "5", "Informal or formal frameworks, models, concepts, and/or theories used to explain the problem, any reasons or assumptions that were used to develop the intervention(s), and reasons why the intervention(s) was expected to work"],
    ["Specific aims", "6", "Purpose of the project and of this report"],
    "METHODS: What did you do?",
    ["Context", "7", "Contextual elements considered important at the outset of introducing the intervention(s)"],
    ["Intervention(s)", "8a", "Description of the intervention(s) in sufficient detail that others could reproduce it"],
    ["", "8b", "Specifics of the team involved in the work"],
    ["Study of the intervention(s)", "9a", "Approach chosen for assessing the impact of the intervention(s)"],
    ["", "9b", "Approach used to establish whether the observed outcomes were due to the intervention(s)"],
    ["Measures", "10a", "Measures chosen for studying processes and outcomes of the intervention(s), including rationale for choosing them, their operational definitions, and their validity and reliability"],
    ["", "10b", "Description of the approach to the ongoing assessment of contextual elements that contributed to the success, failure, efficiency, and cost"],
    ["", "10c", "Methods employed for assessing completeness and accuracy of data"],
    ["Analysis", "11a", "Qualitative and quantitative methods used to draw inferences from the data"],
    ["", "11b", "Methods for understanding variation within the data, including the effects of time as a variable"],
    ["Ethical considerations", "12", "Ethical aspects of implementing and studying the intervention(s) and how they were addressed, including, but not limited to, formal ethics review and potential conflict(s) of interest"],
    "RESULTS: What did you find?",
    ["Results", "13a", "Initial steps of the intervention(s) and their evolution over time (e.g., time-line diagram, flow chart, or table), including modifications made to the intervention during the project"],
    ["", "13b", "Details of the process measures and outcome"],
    ["", "13c", "Contextual elements that interacted with the intervention(s)"],
    ["", "13d", "Observed associations between outcomes, interventions, and relevant contextual elements"],
    ["", "13e", "Unintended consequences such as unexpected benefits, problems, failures, or costs associated with the intervention(s)"],
    ["", "13f", "Details about missing data"],
    "DISCUSSION: What does it mean?",
    ["Summary", "14a", "Key findings, including relevance to the rationale and specific aims"],
    ["", "14b", "Particular strengths of the project"],
    ["Interpretation", "15a", "Nature of the association between the intervention(s) and the outcomes"],
    ["", "15b", "Comparison of results with findings from other publications"],
    ["", "15c", "Impact of the project on people and systems"],
    ["", "15d", "Reasons for any differences between observed and anticipated outcomes, including the influence of context"],
    ["", "15e", "Costs and strategic trade-offs, including opportunity costs"],
    ["Limitations", "16a", "Limits to the generalizability of the work"],
    ["", "16b", "Factors that might have limited internal validity such as confounding, bias, or imprecision in the design, methods, measurement, or analysis"],
    ["", "16c", "Efforts made to minimize and adjust for limitations"],
    ["Conclusions", "17a", "Usefulness of the work"],
    ["", "17b", "Sustainability"],
    ["", "17c", "Potential for spread to other contexts"],
    ["", "17d", "Implications for practice and for further study in the field"],
    ["", "17e", "Suggested next steps"],
    "OTHER INFORMATION",
    ["Funding", "18", "Sources of funding that supported this work. Role, if any, of the funding organization in the design, implementation, interpretation, and reporting"]
  ];
  const TITLE = "Revised Standards for Quality Improvement Reporting Excellence (SQUIRE 2.0)";
  const NOTES = [
    "The SQUIRE guidelines provide a framework for reporting new knowledge about how to improve healthcare.",
    "The SQUIRE guidelines are intended for reports that describe system level work to improve the quality, safety, and value of healthcare, and used methods to establish that observed outcomes were due to the intervention(s).",
    "A range of approaches exists for improving healthcare. SQUIRE may be adapted for reporting any of these.",
    "Authors should consider every SQUIRE item, but it may be inappropriate or unnecessary to include every SQUIRE element in a particular manuscript.",
    "The SQUIRE Glossary contains definitions of many of the key words in SQUIRE.",
    "The Explanation and Elaboration document provides specific examples of well-written SQUIRE items, and an in-depth explanation of each item.",
    "Please cite SQUIRE when it is used to write a manuscript."
  ];
  const CITE_TXT = "From Ogrinc G, Davies L, Goodman D, Batalden P, Davidoff F, Stevens D. SQUIRE 2.0 (Standards for QUality Improvement Reporting Excellence): revised publication guidelines from a detailed consensus process. BMJ Qual Saf 2016; 25:986-992. doi: ";

  const STORE = "squire-2-0-checklist-v1";
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tp-table tbody");
  const linkify = t => t.replace(/\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g, (_, label, url) => {
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.setAttribute("target", "_blank"); a.setAttribute("rel", "noopener");
    a.setAttribute("data-url", url); a.textContent = label;
    return a.outerHTML;
  });
  document.getElementById("tp-notes").innerHTML = NOTES.map(n => `<li>${n}</li>`).join("");
  tbody.innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string"
    ? `<tr class="sec"><td colspan="4">${r}</td></tr>`
    : `<tr><td class="topic">${r[0]}</td><td class="item">${r[1]}</td><td class="txt">${linkify(r[2])}</td>` +
      `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="p${r[1]}" placeholder="page no." aria-label="Page, item ${r[1]}"></td></tr>`).join("");
  tbody.querySelectorAll("a[data-url]").forEach(a => { a.href = a.getAttribute("data-url"); a.removeAttribute("data-url"); });

  const fields = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    fields().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {}; fields().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  // Save as PDF via the browser print dialog (print CSS shows only the checklist)
  document.getElementById("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = "SQUIRE 2.0 checklist";
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  document.getElementById("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all page numbers and the manuscript title?")) { fields().forEach(i => i.value = ""); save(); }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  // <BUILD>
  function buildDocx(D, ROWS, vals, logo, title, eqLogo, NOTES, CITE_TXT) {
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 17, W = [1500, 700, 7066, 1200], TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
    const line = { style: D.BorderStyle.DOTTED, size: 4, color: "333333" };
    const borders = { top: line, bottom: line, left: line, right: line };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold, italics: o.italics, color: o.color });
    const runs = (text, o = {}) => {
      const out = [], re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        if (m.index > last) out.push(run(text.slice(last, m.index), o));
        out.push(new D.ExternalHyperlink({ link: m[2], children: [new D.TextRun({ text: m[1], font: F, size: o.size || SZ, color: "0563C1", underline: {} })] }));
        last = re.lastIndex;
      }
      if (last < text.length) out.push(run(text.slice(last), o));
      return out;
    };
    const cell = (i, text, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: o.span ? TOTAL : W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnSpan: o.span,
      verticalAlign: o.top ? D.VerticalAlign.TOP : D.VerticalAlign.CENTER,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: 90, right: 90 }, borders,
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children: runs(text, o) })]
    });
    const hd = { fill: "4C94D8", bold: true, color: "FFFFFF" };
    const head = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: [
      cell(0, "Section & Item name", hd), cell(1, "No", { ...hd, center: true }),
      cell(2, "Item description *", hd), cell(3, "Reported on page #", { ...hd, center: true })] });
    const body = ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string"
      ? new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r, { span: true, bold: true, color: "215E99" })] })
      : new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [
          cell(0, r[0], { top: true, italics: true, color: "215E99" }), cell(1, r[1], { center: true, top: true }), cell(2, r[2]),
          cell(3, vals["p" + r[1]] || "", { center: true })] }));
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, ...o, children });
    const top = [];
    if (eqLogo) top.push(para([new D.ImageRun({ data: eqLogo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 140, height: Math.round(140 * 90 / 310) } })], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT, spacing: { after: 60 } }));
    top.push(para([new D.TextRun({ text: title, font: F, size: 26, bold: true })], { spacing: { before: 60, after: 120 } }));
    top.push(para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } }));
    return new D.Document({
      title: "SQUIRE 2.0 checklist", creator: "SQUIRE 2.0 checklist",
      sections: [{
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 720, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [...top, new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [head, ...body] }),
          para([run("* Notes to authors", { bold: true, size: 16 })], { spacing: { before: 160, after: 40 } }),
          ...NOTES.map(n => para([run("\u2022  " + n, { size: 16 })], { spacing: { after: 20 }, indent: { left: 300, hanging: 220 } })),
          para(runs(CITE_TXT + "[[10.1136/bmjqs-2015-004411|https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjqs-2015-004411]]", { size: 16 }), { spacing: { before: 160 } })]
      }]
    });
  }
  // </BUILD>

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      const logo = null;
      let eqLogo = null;
      try { eqLogo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/equator_logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {}; fields().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string" ? r : [r[0], r[1], r[2].replace(/\|([^|\]]*)\]\]/, (_, u) => "|" + new URL(u, document.baseURI).href + "]]")]), vals, logo, TITLE, eqLogo, NOTES, CITE_TXT));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = "SQUIRE-2.0-checklist.docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
